descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role This role involves providing engineering troubleshooting & solutions. Source and purchase consumables, equipment, and parts. Manage internal and external subcontracted work. Develop repair specifications, drawings, forms, and processes. Including support project management Technical Representative Sulzer offers you a wealth of opportunities to drive your career into the direction that you want, depending on your skills and interests. We invite you to apply if you are ready to take the next step. Your main tasks and responsibilities: Responsible for all technical information and specifications for each project including:
• Repair specifications, Inspection forms, drawings / prints, material specifications
• Respond to internal requests for inspection and budgetary repair work scopes
• Issue inspection work scopes and estimates
• Review inspection results and evaluate repair solutions
• Write repair work scopes and submit estimates
• Maintain/update repair and inspection service profile templates
• Provide engineering troubleshooting & solutions
• Source and purchase consumables, equipment, and parts To succeed in this role, you will need:
• Engineering degree or at least 4 years’ experience in turbo machinery. No visa or work permit support can be provided for this role. Do you have a question about the role? Reach out to Jerome Blalack at Jerome.Blalack@sulzer.com or Hiring Manager – Billy Bottera. What we offer you
• 11 Paid Holidays
• 15 Paid Time off (PTO) Days
• Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability
• 401k with 6% company match
• Employee Assistance Program
• Employee Wellness Program
• Bonus Programs
• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center) Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.
